label: KDouble
description: This extension for Karoo adds custom data fields: double, triple and sextuple fields (HR, power, etc.) with vertical and horizontal layouts, rolling fields, smart climb field, W prime, FTP and a bell option
releaseNotes: New Triple field: three metrics in one slot, as a row or a column (KTriple One starts with Ascent / Descent / Grade). New optional switch on Double and Triple fields hides a metric that has no data, for example Distance Remain without a route, so the rest use the space. A sensor that drops or a route you clear no longer leaves its old value frozen on screen. Triple and vertical Double fields now work in a full-width slot a third of the screen high, and Triple rows show the icon above the number like Double fields. New Diagnostic log switch (General tab, off by default) records a log to send when a field misbehaves. Minor fixes (valves). Upgrading from below 3.4.0 still needs uninstall and reinstall - note your settings first.
